notes: GLiNER2.5-Decide LiteRT (litert-community/GLiNER2.5-Decide-LiteRT, published 2026-09-26, Hub revision db80197): DeBERTa-v3-large encoder + classification head of fastino/GLiNER2.5-Decide (rev 7ee5da4c), window N=128 encoded tokens, up to 32 labels; inputs inputs_embeds [1,128,1024] / attention_mask [1,128] / label_routing [1,32,128] float32, output logits [1,1,1,32]; the host looks up the word embeddings and turns the logits into decisions. fp32 reference graph: float32 weights (1,634 operators), published under fp32/. GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated Android setting; the runtime's default GPU precision compiled and returned finite logits but flipped 28 of 42 decisions on the s128 fp32 graph (recorded in the s128 fp32 file). artifact_sha256 = the gate's pushed-model sha256, equal to the Hub LFS sha256 (resolve URL x-linked-etag, read 2026-09-26) and the lane's shipment manifest. Every number recomputed from the lane's JSONs / raw outputs (SUPERVISOR.md is the recount log); model-level facts only, no op row derives from these records.
